t: Grove City's downtown: DORA helping businesses thrive, leaders say
s: October 7, 2022 - Three years after it was created, Grove City's Designated Outdoor Refreshment Area has been through some changes and still is credited with helping the downtown area maintain its economic viability. The DORA concept began with the passage of Ohio House Bill 47 in 2015, allowing communities with at least 35,000 residents to designate a DORA zone that allows people to consume beer and wine outdoors when patronizing participating businesses.
